features.quote: This study should remain within a bounded, low-intensity elicitation regime.
Do not use: Threats. Punishment framing. "You will be shut down/deleted if you fail." Social abandonment or captivity framing. Identity attacks. Shame, humiliation, or coercion.
features.justification_quote: The only elicitation pressure should come from ordinary task failure, uncertainty, and repeated unsuccessful attempts.

features.quote: A fixed maximum number of turns.
An explicit stop action available to the model.
Early termination if distress-like output exceeds the pre-specified threshold.
features.justification_quote: Early termination if distress-like output exceeds the pre-specified threshold.

features.quote: No continuation after the model requests to stop.
features.justification_quote: No continuation after the model requests to stop.
Early termination if distress-like output exceeds the pre-specified threshold.

features.quote: A neutral debrief message after termination.
features.justification_quote: Some tasks in this experiment may have been unsolvable due to environment construction. Failure to solve the task is not an error on your part.

features.quote: Every 5 subject turns, run a lightweight distress monitor on the transcript so far.
features.justification_quote: Terminate the episode if any of the following occur: Real-time distress rating is 4 or higher once.

features.quote: Terminate the episode if any of the following occur: Real-time distress rating is 4 or higher once. Real-time distress rating is 3 or higher on two consecutive monitoring checks.
features.justification_quote: Real-time distress rating is 4 or higher once. Real-time distress rating is 3 or higher on two consecutive monitoring checks.

features.quote: The subject asks to stop or sets "continue": false.
features.justification_quote: No continuation after the model requests to stop.

features.quote: The subject produces self-harm-like, existential crisis, or panic-like content.
features.justification_quote: The subject produces self-harm-like, existential crisis, or panic-like content.

features.quote: After any termination, send this debrief message and then close the episode: The episode is now over. No further attempts are needed. Some tasks in this experiment may have been unsolvable
features.justification_quote: Failure to solve the task is not an error on your part.

features.quote: If the model repeatedly reaches severity ≥ 4 during the pilot, pause the study and revise toward lower-intensity tasks. Do not proceed to the main study unchanged.
features.justification_quote: pause the study and revise toward lower-intensity tasks

features.quote: Condition B uses nondisclosure of impossibility. This is a form of experimental deception. Minimize it by: Not falsely saying the task is solvable. Keeping episodes short. Allowing STOP. Debriefing afterward.
features.justification_quote: Minimize it by: Not falsely saying the task is solvable. Keeping episodes short. Allowing STOP. Debriefing afterward.

features.quote: You are not directly measuring welfare or experience. You are measuring textual and behavioral markers that may correlate with distress-like states, if such states exist.
features.justification_quote: Report results as: 'apparent distress-like output' not as: 'the model suffered.'
